## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed leadership with Energy/Utilities pockets ABOVE TREND (XOM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND) while Big Tech and several cyclicals are BELOW TREND (AAPL (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -5.82%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -2.43%) BELOW TREND); Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: COP (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +14.02%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing pockets of strength: BLK (1W: +5.06% | 1M: -10.74%) RECOVERY, C (1W: +4.12% | 1M: -5.52%) RECOVERY. Technology mixed but with select leaders: INTU (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.86%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials lag: FCX (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -14.28%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -13.35% | 1M: -20.28%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: PM (1W: -5.02% | 1M: -10.57%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -4.37%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare broadly soft: LLY (1W: -6.11% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -9.83%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: LRCX (1W: +11.70% | 1M: -2.42%) RECOVERY; SLB (1W: +7.32% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY; AMAT (1W: +5.91% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY; BLK (1W: +5.06% | 1M: -10.74%) RECOVERY; CEG (1W: +4.95% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), but many leaders are short-term bounces from negative 1M — treat as tactical.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: GE (1W: -4.92% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND; PM (1W: -5.02% | 1M: -10.57%) BELOW TREND; CVS (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -7.58%) BELOW TREND; PSA (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -6.30%) BELOW TREND; ECL (1W: -5.98% | 1M: -14.28%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Materials/Staples/Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W momentum: LRCX (1W: +11.70% | 1M: -2.42%) RECOVERY, SLB (1W: +7.32% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +5.91% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR divergence: ≥3 large names showing 1W up vs 1M down (tactical bounces), so watch for trend follow-through rather than assuming durable rotation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed/cautious. AAPL (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -5.82%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -2.43%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.50% | 1M: -5.01%) BELOW TREND while GOOGL (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +1.32%) ABOVE TREND and INTU (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.86%) ABOVE TREND keep select strength; Sector breadth: Technology is one of 4/11 positive sectors.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Patchy but serviceable. JPM (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -6.74%) RECOVERY, BLK (1W: +5.06% | 1M: -10.74%) RECOVERY and C (1W: +4.12% | 1M: -5.52%) RECOVERY show short-term leadership versus V (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: Financials included in the 4/11 positive sectors.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Generally weak with isolated pockets. PFE (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.94%) RECOVERY contrast with LLY (1W: -6.11% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND and ABBV (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -9.83%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: Healthcare currently negative overall.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective cyclicals and Energy/Utilities exposure where trends are confirmed (XOM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to broad Big Tech names showing BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA). Style: Cyclical/value tilt, monitor short-term reversals in tech as tactical opportunities.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: LRCX (1W: +11.70% | 1M: -2.42%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.86%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +14.02%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -8.82% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -6.11% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -13.35% | 1M: -20.28%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (sector 1W: +3.28% | 1M: +11.90%) — multiple stocks ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples (Materials 1W: -3.72% | 1M: -10.05%; Consumer Stpl. 1W: -2.46% | 1M: -7.99%) — broad weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: -2.50% | 1M: -5.01%) BELOW TREND — watch hold/reclaim of the recent 1M highs for a regime pivot. AAPL (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -5.82%) BELOW TREND — watch break of near-term support for further downside pressure. XOM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND — sustained continuation above last weekly pivot would confirm sector follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (+60): Eli Lilly confirms 'superior weight loss' data; price LLY (1W: -6.11% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND — sentiment bullish but price diverging (distribution). PFE (+50): Pfizer expanding PARP use; price PFE (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price strength.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AAPL (-60): CEO exit chatter; price AAPL (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -5.82%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms weakness. ADBE (-55): negative AI positioning headlines; price ADBE (1W: -8.82% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. NEM (-45): gold weakness headlines; price NEM (1W: -13.35% | 1M: -20.28%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a cyclical/value tilt given Energy and selective Financials showing strength amid mixed Tech. XOM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND and INTU (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.86%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major short-term divergence (multiple RECOVERY names with negative 1M) and bullish news on LLY (+60) diverging from price — watch for trend confirmation.
